PLAN (bd-3aen, BeigeFern): Loop --engine parity gate.

STATE: bd-e0xk slice 1 landed (flywheel 168cd8b) — `flywheel loop run --engine` coexistence path exists (engine_loop in durable.rs, loop-dispatch workflow). Gate script scripts/e2e-hardened-loop.sh runs 6 scenarios against the LEGACY imperative loop only — no --engine mode.

STEPS:
1. Add engine mode to scripts/e2e-hardened-loop.sh (LOOP_MODE=engine env -> appends --engine to all `flywheel loop run` invocations; bar-for-bar identical checks).
2. Run legacy pass -> record PASS/FAIL per scenario (baseline).
3. Run --engine pass -> record PASS/FAIL per scenario.
4. Compare bar-for-bar: all 6 must be IDENTICAL (same verdict + same evidence semantics).
5. If parity holds: close with evidence; note legacy removal is one phase AFTER this proof (per bd-e0xk, NOT in this bead's scope).
6. If a scenario diverges: diagnose engine path (durable.rs engine_loop), fix, re-run.

RISKS: scenario 5 needs SIGSTOP timing on real agent send-leaves (resonate rows); scenario 4 blocked-state may not be producible on this herdr build (script documents that fallback). Both must match legacy verdicts exactly.

ENV: herdr up, resonate up (:8001), br present, flywheel 0.2.0 built.
